title: Stained Glass Heraldic Crest
description: A close-up view of a damaged stained glass panel depicting a heraldic coat of arms. The shield is quartered in teal and black with three golden pinecones and a blue fleur-de-lis, topped by a blue knight's helmet with a white cross, surrounded by ornate teal and blue scrollwork, with a banner below reading 'FOREL'.
prompt: Close-up photograph of an antique leaded stained glass window featuring a heraldic shield, the shield is divided into four quadrants of teal and black containing three golden pinecones and a prominent blue fleur-de-lis at the bottom, surmounted by a blue knight helmet with white cross, flanked by elaborate teal and royal blue acanthus leaf scrollwork, a white banner underneath with the word FOREL in black gothic lettering, visible cracks and missing glass pieces, realistic textures and lead lines
